glosses: engagement ring or wedding ring (ring exchanged between bride and groom)
alliance (pact or treaty between countries or parties made to advance common goals)
alliance (countries or parties which form an alliance)

examples.text: Tom era casado, mas não usava aliança.
examples.en: Tom was married, but he didn't wear a ring.

examples.text: Tom não quer comprar uma aliança cara para Mary.
examples.en: Tom doesn't want to buy an expensive engagement ring for Mary.

examples.text: Ela não quer que ele compre uma aliança de compromisso cara.
examples.en: She doesn't want him to buy an expensive engagement ring.

examples.text: Tom deu a Mary uma aliança de noivado.
examples.en: Tom gave Mary an engagement ring.
